definitions.explanation: A person who swims, especially one engaged in swimming as an activity or sport.

examples.japanese: {遠泳|えんえい}の{泳者|えいしゃ}たちが{海|うみ}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: The long-distance swimmers entered the sea.

examples.japanese: {泳者|えいしゃ}の{安全|あんぜん}を{守|まも}るためにライフガードが{配置|はいち}された。
examples.english: Lifeguards were stationed to protect the swimmers' safety.

examples.japanese: トライアスロンの{泳者|えいしゃ}たちは、{過酷|かこく}なコースを{泳|およ}ぎ{切|き}って{次|つぎ}のステージに{進|すす}んだ。
examples.english: The triathletes swam through the grueling course and advanced to the next stage.

notes:
A compound of {泳|えい} (swimming) and {者|しゃ} (person). This is a somewhat formal or literary word. In everyday conversation, {泳|およ}ぐ{人|ひと} (person who swims) or the loanword スイマー (swimmer) is more common. {泳者|えいしゃ} tends to appear in news reports, sports coverage, and written descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠泳|えんえい}の{泳者|えいしゃ}: long-distance swimmer
- {泳者|えいしゃ}の{安全|あんぜん}: swimmer safety
- {競泳|きょうえい}{泳者|えいしゃ}: competitive swimmer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スイマー: swimmer (loanword; more casual and commonly used in sports)
- {水泳選手|すいえいせんしゅ}: competitive swimmer; swimming athlete
- {泳|およ}ぎ{手|て}: swimmer (native Japanese compound; informal)
